items.name: c-questionnaire-1
items.title: Guided workspace setup
items.description: Three required questions in a card, with progress, navigation and a summary on submit.
items.descriptionLong: Guided workspace setup. Built by composing Button, Card, Questionnaire. A free, open source shadcn questionnaire example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-questionnaire-1 and edit as your own code.

items.name: c-questionnaire-2
items.title: Multi-select answers
items.description: A checkbox question that accepts several answers, with a live count and a chip summary.
items.descriptionLong: Multi-select answers. Built by composing Badge, Button, Card, Questionnaire. A free, open source shadcn questionnaire example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-questionnaire-2 and edit as your own code.

items.name: c-questionnaire-3
items.title: A written answer beside the choices
items.description: A text input sitting with the fixed choices, so an answer can be typed instead of picked.
items.descriptionLong: A written answer beside the choices. Built by composing Button, Card, Label, Questionnaire. A free, open source shadcn questionnaire example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-questionnaire-3 and edit as your own code.

items.name: c-questionnaire-4
items.title: Segmented progress with step labels
items.description: A custom progress bar built from the progress render state, over a four question flow.
items.descriptionLong: Segmented progress with step labels. Built by composing Button, Empty, Questionnaire. Uses cn alongside the shadcn primitives. A free, open source shadcn questionnaire example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-questionnaire-4 and edit as your own code.

items.name: c-questionnaire-5
items.title: An optional question with skip
items.description: A question the visitor may skip on purpose, with the skipped state carried into the summary.
items.descriptionLong: An optional question with skip. Built by composing Badge, Button, Card, Questionnaire. Uses @shadcn/react alongside the shadcn primitives. A free, open source shadcn questionnaire example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-questionnaire-5 and edit as your own code.

items.name: c-questionnaire-6
items.title: A rule that sends you back
items.description: A cross-question rule checked on submit, returning the flow to the question that broke it.
items.descriptionLong: A rule that sends you back. Built by composing Button, Card, Questionnaire. A free, open source shadcn questionnaire example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-questionnaire-6 and edit as your own code.

items.name: c-questionnaire-7
items.title: A branch that appears when it applies
items.description: A question that only joins the flow after an earlier answer, with avatars, reset and a summary.
items.descriptionLong: A branch that appears when it applies. Built by composing Avatar, Button, Card, Questionnaire. Uses cn alongside the shadcn primitives. A free, open source shadcn questionnaire example you can install with npx shadcn@latest add @reui/c-questionnaire-7 and edit as your own code.
